$description: DataGrid: its tokens at the compact density.

data-grid-text-line-height.$description: DataGrid: a line of cell text in taller rows (and the line P is measured against): 16px at Compact.

data-grid-header-type-icon-size.$description: DataGrid column header type icon: hidden in Compact (a 28px header row is too small for it).

data-grid-header-type-icon-gap.$description: DataGrid column header: no gap where the type icon is hidden (Compact).

data-grid-view-column-width.$description: DataGrid: the view column at the end of the header (the view menu's button): as wide as the checkbox column.

data-grid-header-height.$description: DataGrid column header: 28px at Compact, the titles unchanged (owner, 2026-10-23: Windows Explorer’s header).
